run_visualize_policy: run the visualize_policy CLI to render a saved policy on a MuJoCo environment for a set number of episodes
run_visualize_policy_with_seed: run the visualize_policy CLI with a custom seed to reproduce deterministic policy visualization results
run_visualize_policy_exploration: run the visualize_policy CLI in exploration mode to see stochastic policy behavior on the environment
run_visualize_policy_default_mlp: run the visualize_policy CLI without a policy file to render a default MLP policy on the environment
run_visualize_policy_custom_episodes: run the visualize_policy CLI with a custom episode count to control how many rollouts are visualized
